steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: A few years ago, we became the Infected.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: We were forced to live among the shadows. Overnight, peace became a luxury for us.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Originally, we thought that the Reunion Movement would be able to change our lives, but...

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Still, nobody would sell us bread or provide us shelter. Nothing had changed at all.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: My brothers and I left, and we drifted from place to place until we heard about the treasure. That is what brought me here.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: This time, if we're able to get our hands on the treasure...

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: We'd be able to travel to Columbia, far, far away. There, the Infected can form communities and even own land.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: That is why... Grani, for my brothers, I need this treasure.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: It's not far... I can feel it. You did well, but it's a shame...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Hey, lady! You...!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Out of my way.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Woah!!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I don't care who you are, or what you plan on doing.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: But you shall disappear from my sight.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: If there's really no other way, Skadi... then I'll fight you to the very end.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: So these are the types of people you've chosen to ally yourself with?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: What will happen to Dewville after you take the treasure?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: No matter what happens, they will still survive. The same cannot be said for us.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Even though I haven't known you for long, I can tell what kind of person you are.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: You aren't prejudiced against the Infected, unlike that monster standing next to you.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: (Skadi probably isn't prejudiced either... She just wants you out of her way, Infected or not...)

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Grani, tell me where Carol is!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: You know how much this treasure means to us!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Sorry, Big Bob, but that's not a part of my mission.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: My only mission is to help Carol find the treasure, and restore peace to her village.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I don't care about any of that. Just hand Carol over to me.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: What do you need that girl for anyway, you monster?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Do you plan to skin her alive? Drink her blood?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: You already heard the kid. She won't hand the chief over to you no matter what!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: However, I just want the treasure. I won't lay a finger on the girl!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I've had enough of this... Grani, tell me where Carol is.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: All Carol wants is to protect her village. She doesn't even care about the treasure itself.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: In that case, let me have the treasure then!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: There is little difference between Reunion and the bounty hunters.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: I'm nothing like you greed-driven lot!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: I used to be a good-for-nothing just like you, but I've seen the world for what it is.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Right now, things like status or wealth aren't worth shit.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: All we want is to survive, and the treasure is going to make that happen!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I'll say it one more time. Hand Carol over to me.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I won't hand over Carol, or the treasure.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: This is my mission.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Grani! You still have a choice! I don't want to fight you when it doesn't do either of us any good!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Just let me have the treasure, and everyone walks away happy!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: We already agreed that we'd give you a share of the treasure, Big Bob!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: But think about my brothers! At least let me see how much treasure there is first!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: If we have to resort to violence, both of you know that you're no match for me.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I might not be confident in my abilities, but if I have to fight both of you, then so be it!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: At least the two of us can talk things through, Grani!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Then, let's team up and take her down first!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Are you done talking?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: If we start fighting here, then there really will be no turning back!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: We...
Grani!
Look, I found the it! I found the treasure!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: It was really hard to drag it all the way out here...

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Mister Bob!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: I'm glad that you're okay—

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Stay back!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: ...Tsk!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: *huff*...*huff*...

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: There was... never any turning back for us!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Huh? Carol!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Skadi!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Why did you use a non-damaging explosive?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: I owe these girls a favor.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: But next time, I'll be using the real ones.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Skadi...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: You don't care about the treasure. Nor do you want to hurt Miss Carol.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: That's why you shielded her instead of grabbing the treasure and making a run for it.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I'm not after the treasure. What I want is the answer that Carol holds.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Why didn't you say so in the first place?!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: What's the point of playing the villain anyway? Wouldn't kill you to be a bit more frank.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I don't want... for others to get caught up in my mission.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: But the mission objective this time... is very important to me.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Of course, I can imagine. Even though we have different missions, we're working towards the same thing, right?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: We should be helping each other out instead!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I guess we're going to have to fight over the treasure after all.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Skadi, make sure not to hurt him too badly!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Gra...ni...!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I'm really sorry, Big Bob, but this might hurt a little!
